issues: Chain tile data-testid casing is inconsistent across the two swaps: Private route uses lowercase (dk-chain-ethereum, dk-chain-bsc, dk-chain-ton) while Privacy swap uses Title-Case with hyphens (dk-chain-Ethereum, dk-chain-BNB-Chain, dk-chain-NEAR). Not a user-visible bug but will trip automated tests that assume one convention.
Destination-address input testid is inconsistent across the two swaps: Private route exposes dk-dest-addr; Privacy swap exposes dk-dest. Consider unifying to dk-dest-addr.

action_items: (Low) Normalize dk-chain-* data-testid casing to lowercase on both Private route and Privacy swap destination modals.
(Low) Rename privacy-swap destination-address input testid from dk-dest to dk-dest-addr for parity with private-route.
critical_code_review_comments: User-reported mobile wrap issue (tabbar on 2 rows / segmented control wrapping) is NOT reproducible on the current build at 390x844 — tabbar is one row (6 items, all top=784) and segmented control is one line (all top=96). Issue appears already fixed by the latest mobile CSS rules in backend/brand/dk-swap.js.
Token loading, popularSort ordering, chainIconFor icon fallback, and order creation on both /api/ds/* and /api/ds/near/* are all working end-to-end against live upstreams.
Minor: data-testid casing/naming inconsistency between the two swap views (listed in design_issues).
test_credentials: None required (wallet connect not needed for order creation).
